title: Agricultural Produce Markets Sindh Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Agricultural Produce Markets Sindh Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1994
AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT IV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Agricultural Produce Market (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 22nd December, 1993 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 25th August, 1993.

sections.shortTitle: Agricultural Produce Markets Sindh Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of Act V of 1939

ACT IV OF 1994
AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT IV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Agricultural Produce Market (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 22nd December, 1993 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of Act V of 1939.--In the Agricultural Produce Markets
Act, 1939, for the words and commas Director General, Bureau of Supply and
Prices, Sindh' wherever occurring the words and comma "Director General,
Agriculture Extension" shall be substituted.
